title: ReadOnBranchRequest
description: Which files to read and which folders to list at a commit, and the name of the worktree to read them in.

cutAs.description: The name of the worktree cut for the reading, removed after it; its branch stays.

base.description: The commit or branch to read at.

paths.description: The files to read, relative to the project.

list.description: Folders whose files to list, with the files in their folders, relative to the project; left out, none.
